explanation: This fires only at D1 and only in the last ~10 trials of the episode (trial 90 onward, mostly 94-99), when the previous trial chose a1, reached S1 and was rewarded; it builds over a run of such trials (roughly 1-5 on the first, then 6-8, then 9-10 by the third or fourth in a row). It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at every step before trial ~90, and at D1 right after a trial that reached S2 or (usually) went unrewarded.
